summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of মানিকগঞ্জ অনলাইন সেবা. All 36 pytest backend tests PASSED (auth, public CRUD on 19 collections, DC singleton, complaints/join_requests forms, admin CRUD with auth-gating, full create→read→update→delete cycle, DC upsert). Frontend Expo web app loads with 0 page errors; verified home (header+marquee+slider+services+ads+DC+upazilas+e-services+bottom nav), service detail, restaurant, emergency, blood (with blood-group filter chips), upazila tab+detail+schools sub-page, profile, complaint, join-request, and admin login → admin dashboard with all 22 collection tabs and edit/delete/toggle controls.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow), props.pointerEvents deprecated, useNativeDriver missing on web — RN-Web compatibility warnings only, not functional bugs. Cosmetic cleanup recommended.

action_items: (Optional) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow on web or guard with Platform.select to silence deprecation warnings.

(Optional) Add testID props to TouchableOpacity/Pressable across screens for more reliable automated testing in future iterations (currently we relied on get_by_text which works but is fragile to label changes).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file ~435 lines — within limits; clean separation of auth/seed/CRUD. Generic CRUD factory using collection allowlist is solid.
All Mongo find calls correctly project {'_id': 0} — verified no _id leak in any of 19 public collections + DC + admin endpoints.
JWT secret has a hardcoded fallback; acceptable for dev but should be set via env in production.
POST /api/admin/{collection} accepts arbitrary Dict[str, Any] payload — flexible by design, but no per-collection schema validation; intentional given dynamic admin panel.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; no hardcoded URLs found in calls.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (10 screens + admin login)

seed_data_creation: No additional seed data created. Auto-seeded sample data verified (services=9, upazilas=7, e_services=6, etc.). Test data prefixed with 'TEST_' was created and cleaned up within test_full_crud_cycle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://monipur-services.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend env variable is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Admin creds: admin@manikganj.com / Admin@123. Admin login navigates to /admin and shows 22 collection tabs. Splash overlay ~2.4s fades cleanly; we waited 3s+ before asserting. Use get_by_text for Bangla labels — testID props are not yet present on most interactive elements.
rca_of_issue: No bugs detected. App is in healthy state matching all spec requirements in the review request.
